name: MSNIAGA
recent: MSNIAGA 于 2026 年 10 月获得一份价值 RM32.3mil 的 Customs 合约，并在同月出现董事会成员变动。公司于 2026 年 8 月发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩，随后于 11 月披露一项重大诉讼。
notable: 获得价值 RM32.3mil 的 Customs 合约。
董事会成员出现变动，包括 Encik Khairul Azizi Bin Ismail 和 Puan Shazurawati Binti Abd Karim 的职位变动。

ann.title: Change in Boardroom - ENCIK KHAIRUL AZIZI BIN ISMAIL
Change in Boardroom - PUAN SHAZURAWATI BINTI ABD KARIM
Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: MSNIAGA secured a RM32.3mil Customs contract in October 2026 and saw boardroom changes in the same month. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 in August 2026, and subsequently disclosed a material litigation in November.
notable_en: Boardroom changes involving Encik Khairul Azizi Bin Ismail and Puan Shazurawati Binti Abd Karim.
